articles.title: Israeli settlers attack West Bank village and block Palestinian family's return home
articles.description: Two homes belonging to the al-Tubasi family were set on fire and Israeli security forces were also targeted by settlers.

articles.title: First female prime minister named in Morocco after winning elections
articles.description: Her appointment by the king makes her only the second woman to lead a government in the Arab world.

articles.title: French hard-right leader accuses opponents of 'total war' after claims of antisemitism
articles.description: National Rally President Jordan Bardella says he will sue for libel over comments he is accused of making as a young activist.

articles.title: Morocco names first female prime minister after historic election victory
articles.description: Morocco has named its first-ever female prime minister, and only the second woman to hold the position in the Arab world, following an election.

articles.title: Bill Gates warns AI global framework talks harder than Cold War-era nuclear negotiations
articles.description: Microsoft founder Bill Gates has warned that getting countries to agree on a global framework for AI could be more difficult than Cold War-era negotiations to restrict nuclear weapons.
